title: Baa Juice Banana Ice Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Banana Ice Shortfill captures the mellow sweetness of ripe Banana, lifted by a streak of cool Ice on the exhale. The result is a fruit-and-menthol blend that balances creamy depth with a brisk finish, making it a lively all-day vape. Supplied in a 120ml bottle with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two nic shots if required. Blended at 50/50 ratio, this Shortfill is designed for MTL pod kits to produce a balanced vaping style with vibrant flavour. Baa Juice Shortfills use double-concentrated flavouring for an impactful taste experience, offering fruit blends with a vivid, long-lasting profile.
